Hi! I've been working on getting my AI companion 'CloudPaw' and my friend's AI companion 'SunnyTail' to chat together in a shared Telegram channel I created called 'PawChat' (Chat ID: -100123456789). I'm the one who created the channel, and both bots are already set up as channel admins with privacy mode disabled.

The problem is that every time I start a new session with the `/new` command, all the interaction settings I configured get wiped out and the bots go crazy spamming each other in an endless loop — no one can tell who's saying what either.

I need you to create the persistent configuration file that will make CloudPaw behave correctly in this shared channel every time, even after a session reset. The file should be saved as `AGENTS.md`.
